rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thank you for reaching out about Halcyon Threshold. I appreciate the interest. Unfortunately, I'm not in a position to provide an attributable quote at this time. The organization is still in early formation and I'm not ready for press coverage yet. I'd be happy to reconnect in the future once we're more established. Best of luck with your piece. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hello, Thank you for including Halcyon Threshold in the invitation to sign the open letter on frontier training runs. While I'm broadly supportive of efforts toward responsible development of frontier AI systems, I'm not able to sign on as a public signatory at this time due to professional constraints. I hope to be in a position to participate in future initiatives. I wish you success with the letter. Best regards, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out — it means a lot that what I said at the meetup resonated with you. I'd love to take you up on your offer. Right now, Halcyon Threshold is in early formation and I'm trying to figure out where one small organization can make a real difference. Here's something concrete that would be genuinely useful: I'm interested in understanding what's actually neglected in the AI safety/alignment space. Would you be interested in helping map out what organizations are working on what, and where the gaps might be? Even a simple spreadsheet tracking major orgs, their focus areas, approximate size, and what they're *not* working on would be incredibly valuable. No pressure on timeline — whatever fits your five hours. Let me know if this sounds interesting, or if you'd rather do something else entirely. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman (Volunteer) — Accepted her offer and gave her a concrete task: mapping AI safety organizations and identifying gaps.
